task: FORECASTBUNDLE RESEARCH GOVERNANCE DECISION RECORD D4 - DEFERRED WIND CAPABILITY

current_research_capability_state.solar_forecasting: Developed, evaluated, and frozen as Stage8.1 champion
current_research_capability_state.wind_forecasting: Not yet developed, evaluated, or selected

governance_decision_d4.name: Wind Forecasting - Deferred Future Capability
governance_decision_d4.statement: POLARIS shall not currently designate the existing prototype wind mechanism as the authoritative wind-generation forecasting source. Wind forecasting shall remain a deferred future research and engineering capability.

reason_for_deferral: Strict scientific provenance; technical availability of prototype does not equal scientific model development.
POLARIS does not claim forecasting capabilities that have not undergone model training, feature selection, and validation.
Polar wind forecasting requires dedicated meteorological data, power curve modeling, and validation separate from solar irradiance.

forecastbundle_implication.field_integrity: wind_generation field remains architecturally defined and intact in schema v1.0.
forecastbundle_implication.capability_status_note: Absence of authorized wind source is a capability status fact, not a schema defect.

relationship_to_d1_d2_d3.d1_d2: If a future wind model is authorized, D1 uncertainty bound semantics and D2 point-only degenerate representation apply.
relationship_to_d1_d2_d3.d3: D3 PV mapping authorization does not authorize or validate wind persistence. D3 and D4 remain strictly decoupled.

d4_frozen_contract_assessment.reasoning: ForecastBundle schema v1.0 retains wind_generation field. Deferring the source does not require a structural schema modification.

architectural_consequence.current_state: Stage8.1 solar forecast mapped to solar_generation; wind field architecturally intact but unpopulated by an authorized source.
architectural_consequence.future_intent: Multi-source composition combining solar, wind, and demand forecasts into ForecastBundle.

scientific_claim_limitations: Records capability status and governance only. Does not claim wind forecasting skill, power curve validation, or EMS optimization superiority.
